item.title: Demand Exception Reports: Purpose, Review Process, and Practical Challenges
item.description: A Demand Exception Report is an analytical tool used in demand planning and S&OP to identify the products that require human investigation. This guide covers exception categories such as forecast variance, bias, spikes, stockout distortions and launch deviations, plus an eight-step review process and the practical challenges of designing a report that planners actually use.

item.title: Demand Planning KPIs: Learning Notes on Forecast Accuracy Metrics
item.description: Eight forecast KPIs that come up constantly in demand planning — with the formula, the business meaning, and the trap hidden inside each one.
